target: temporary workers.dev Worker and temporary Cloudflare R2 bucket

methodology.execution: Disposable Azure Node 22 callers compared sequential ordinary HTTP writes with one authoritative putMany commit against isolated R2 prefixes.
methodology.matrix: 25,000 documents, two covering indexes, Snapshot and Trie, and logical groups of 1, 5, and 20 mutations.
methodology.primaryLatency: clientElapsedMs measured one complete logical mutation group. Read-your-writes verification ran after the timer.
methodology.durability: Every successful write awaited immutable objects and final conditional HEAD publication.

limitations: The regional matrix focuses on the large two-index profile after a broader local preflight.
The separate-write control runs sequential HTTP requests from one caller and does not model concurrent browser requests.
The benchmark does not include an application-level coalescing delay.
Azure regions approximate geography and do not represent residential last-mile networks.
One Cloudflare account and one R2 bucket placement were used.
Authentication and browser rendering were excluded.
Cloudflare Worker timers do not measure CPU-only work normally.
